expr: [Refine, [Element, [Add, [Power, x, y], [Ln, [Add, x, y]]], RealNumbers], [And, [Greater, x, 0], [Greater, y, 0]]]

wolfram.note: Refine decides an Element claim by evaluating it under the assumptions, which settles a real-valued test but not region containment: ours has no rule that a disc x^2 + y^2 <= 1 lies in Rectangle({-1, -1}, {1, 1}), so it stays unevaluated. Wolfram answers True.
